mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today is balanced dish: we have 72 degree temperatures and overcast skies over at Badger Prairie County Park under a Waxing Gibbous moon.

In city news, the I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students is officially closed for submissions. The community is invited to vote on the winning designs for our November stickers starting July 28 through August 7. Also, residents are reminded to check their mailbox setups to ensure they meet official specifications before the winter plow season begins.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Live music is taking place today at Bailey is Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer is Market at the Capitol or catch more live music at Paddy Mac is.

In a report from the Verona Police Department, an incident occurred on July 13 where an officer discovered a vehicle stuck on a large rock. The 36 year old driver was subsequently arrested for an O-W-I.
The flavor of the day today is the rich and delicious Chocolate Volcano. Culver is of Verona is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so you have plenty of time to plan your visit.
